stem:
Saanvi studies this garden food chain: grass → grasshopper → frog → snake.

Which claims correctly assign trophic levels? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Grass is the producer at the first trophic level.
The grasshopper is a herbivore at the second trophic level.
The frog is the producer because it starts the animal part of the chain.
The snake is at the second trophic level because it is larger than the frog.

teacher.key_rationale: Producers are first; herbivores that eat them are second. The frog is a small carnivore at the third level; the snake is later, not second.
